newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Standard Chart HK unit profit up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chart HK unit profit up 25 pct.

text.p: Standard Chartered Plc said on Wednesday the 1996 operating profit posted by its Hong Kong unit rose 25 percent to HK$3.8 billion.
The British-based bank said its Hong Kong banking businesses were up 17 percent to HK$2.9 billion in calendar 1996.
"These are strong overall results. We have increased our margins, grown our revenues, and continued to manage our costs," David Brougham, group executive director, said in a statement.
"In 1996, our banking and treasury businesses, which represent 95 percent of our activities, performed strongly," he said. "These achievements provide a solid platform for future growth."
